milestones.headline: US President Signs Epstein Files Transparency Act

info.description: The President announced the signing via Truth Social.
info.note: Included with this post are numerous falsities or misleading statements:

info.description: It should be noted that it is fully within the President's purview to order the declassification of such files from the Department of Justice, without an act of Congress, if they so wish, and that this could have been undertaken at any point in the first 10 months of the presidency.

milestones.headline: US Senate Passes Epstein Files Transparency Act

info.description: The Senate passed the act by unanimous consent, sending the bill to the desk of the President.

milestones.headline: US House Passes Epstein Files Transparency Act

info.description: The House passed the act 427-1, with Rep. Clay Higgins (R-LA) being the sole vote against it, sending the bill to the Senate for consideration.

Rep. Higgins stated in a press release that he voted against the bill because it "...reveals and injures thousands of innocent people –[sic] witnesses, people who provided alibis, family members, etc."
info.note: This is despite the bill intentionally using language to protect such individuals.

info.description: Rep. Donald Beyer [D-VA], Rep. Greg Casar [D-TX], Rep. Michael A. Rulli [R-OH], Rep. Mikie Sherill [D-NJ], and Rep. Steve Womack [R-AR] were not present for the vote.
info.note: All save Rep. Rulli indicated current or previous support for the bill, had they been present.

info.description: One email from Jeffrey's Epstein's brother, Mark, to Jeffrey in 2018, has been a source of rampant speculation. That email reads: "Ask him [Bannon] if Putin has the photos of Trump blowing Bubba?"
info.note: The "Bubba" mentioned in the email is the main source of speculation. "Bubba" is a nickname for former president William (Bill) Clinton from his campaigning days in the early 90s. Mark has clarified that the "Bubba" in the email does not refer to Bill Clinton. Speculation occurred also that "Bubba" was the name of one of Ghislaine Maxwell's horses, but this is unconfirmed information.

milestones.headline: DoJ OIG Releases Report on the BOP's Custody, Care, and Supervision of Jeffrey Epstein
Jeffrey Epstein Found Dead in Jail Cell
info: Despite having been put on suicide watch, Jeffrey Epstein was found dead in his jail cell pending trial on August 10, 2019. The official cause of death was ruled as suicide by hanging.
